description: A comprehensive extraction schema for credit reports based on standard bureau mapping requirements.

Report_Identification.CreditReportReferenceNumber: Unique reference number for the credit report
Report_Identification.CreditAgencyName: Name of the credit reporting agency or reseller
Report_Identification.PreparedForName: Entity for whom the report was prepared
Report_Identification.CreditReportOrderedDate: The date the credit report was originally ordered
Report_Identification.OrderDate: Specific date of the order transaction
Report_Identification.CreditFreeze: Indicator if a credit freeze is active

Borrower_Identity.FirstName: Legal first name of the borrower
Borrower_Identity.LastName: Legal last name of the borrower
Borrower_Identity.Suffix: Name suffix such as Jr, Sr, or III
Borrower_Identity.SSN: Social Security Number of the borrower
Borrower_Identity.DOB: Date of birth of the borrower
Borrower_Identity.AKA: List of 'Also Known As' names (AKA1 through AKA20) found on file

Address_Information.AdditionalAddress: Any secondary or previous addresses listed on the report

Bureau_Availability.TransUnionAvailable: Indicator if TransUnion data is present
Bureau_Availability.ExperianAvailable: Indicator if Experian data is present
Bureau_Availability.EquifaxAvailable: Indicator if Equifax data is present

Tradeline_Details.description: Granular data for individual credit accounts (tradelines)

fields.AccountNumber: Account number associated with the debt
fields.Type: The type of credit account (e.g., Revolving, Mortgage)
fields.HighBalance: The highest balance ever recorded on the account
fields.Status: Current status of the account (e.g., Paid, Current)
fields.LastReportActivityDate: Most recent date of activity or reporting
fields.TradelineRemark: Specific remarks or codes on the tradeline

Summary_Totals.TotalMonthlyPayment: Sum of all monthly payments across tradelines

Derogatory_Summary.InquiriesCount: Total number of hard inquiries in the last 12-24 months

description: Detailed extraction schema for residential purchase agreements focusing on financial terms and property types.

Contract_Basics.ContractDate: The date the contract was fully executed
Contract_Basics.OfferDate: The date the initial offer was made
Contract_Basics.ClosingDate: The scheduled date for ownership transfer

Financial_Terms.EarnestMoneyAmount: The deposit amount provided by the buyer
Financial_Terms.SellerPaidClosingCosts: Amount of closing costs covered by the seller
Financial_Terms.SellerCredits: Specific financial credits provided by the seller to the buyer

Property_Attributes.PropertyAddress: Full physical address of the property
Property_Attributes.IsCondominium: Boolean/Indicator if the property is a condo
Property_Attributes.IsPUD: Boolean/Indicator if property is in a Planned Unit Development

Parties_and_Agents.SellerName: Full name of the property owner(s)
Parties_and_Agents.ListingAgentName: Name of the agent representing the seller
Parties_and_Agents.SellingAgentName: Name of the agent representing the buyer
Parties_and_Agents.EscrowCompanyName: The company handling the transaction funds
